scope: Independent bounded front-column color review; not a full-exterior or printability certification.
findings: Personally inspected the official undated photograph. The entrance-facing four columns have a warm gray-brown brick family, supporting the bounded nominal material choice.

Independently reconstructed original cylinder facets using triangle normals snapped to the nearest original 32-gon facet and finite all-vertex bounds. The 328 selected faces exactly match the material changes.
The original 179 crown faces retain their material. All vertices and triangles, STL, build source and parameters are unchanged; 3MF matches the mesh and materials.

Viewed all ten completed rendered images, including full-size front and crown detail. Only the front columns show the new color; windows, other walls, rear columns and roof remain neutral. No caption overlays were visible.
Reopened the final scene and checked geometry, materials, camera, lights and render settings. Hidden caption/backdrop remain hidden and stamps are off.
README explicitly discloses back-facing same-column color continuity as inference and retains partial-color and original printability limitations.
limits: The photograph is undated; no certified 2026 or as-built condition is claimed.
Nominal brick family, not a measured exact color swatch. Unseen/back-facing surfaces of the same four columns are inferred.
No changes to crown recesses, other facades, rear columns, windows, roofs or geometry.
Original simplified geometry and printability limitations remain; no physical print.
numerical_tolerance_note: Original float32 STL triangulation produces side-normal angular jitter up to 5.2e-5 radians. Independent classification snaps normals to known original facets, then checks every vertex against those facet planes within 2e-5 mm; no coordinates are altered.
